annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 530 ("The Inquest of Yawn"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within the judicial inquest over the prostrate body of Yawn (Shaun), voices of the dead rising through him, HCE's final confession. During this Age of Men phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.

annotations.annotation_text: Egyptian eschatology "set" on page 530 ("The Inquest of Yawn"): within the judicial inquest over the prostrate body of Yawn (Shaun), voices of the dead rising through him, HCE's final confession, HCE appears as the dismembered Osiris and ALP as Isis gathering his scattered limbs. Mark Troy's research traces how Joyce embedded the Papyrus of Ani's resurrection liturgy throughout this Age of Men passage — the dream-journey through the underworld (Tuat) toward solar rebirth.

annotations.annotation_text: Tavern/jury motif "porter" on page 530 ("The Inquest of Yawn"): the twelve customers drinking in HCE's Chapelizod pub represent public opinion, the Zodiac, and the Apostles within the judicial inquest over the prostrate body of Yawn (Shaun), voices of the dead rising through him, HCE's final confession. During this Age of Men phase, they judge, condemn, and demand another round — the Greek chorus of middle-class Dublin gossip.
